result.headline: ODC1 is 3.32× higher in MYCN-high samples than in the rest.
lines: With your planned analysis it is called up (higher in MYCN-high).
Likely range from this data: 2.29× to 4.80× higher.
MYCN-high means top 15 % by MYCN expression.
result.verdict_sentence: Same call in 100 of 100 reasonable analyses, and no 5 or fewer samples change it.

lines: 144 reasonable analyses were run: every combination of choices a careful lab could defend.
The difference itself is clear (p below 0.05) in 100 of 100 of them.
Across every option tried, common shortcuts and other group cut-offs included (90,396 analyses), the same answer comes out in 99 of 100.

leans: No 5 or fewer of the 366 samples change the call.
At 3.32× higher it is 66 % beyond the 2× line a call needs.
